entities.name: The Helvault
entities.description: A silver monolith made from a piece of Innistrad's silver moon, created by Sorin as a prison for supernatural creatures; destroyed when Liliana threatened Thalia.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the Helvault stood.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker, grandson of Edgar Markov, who created Avacyn and the Helvault.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Created vampirism on Innistrad and cursed his grandson Sorin.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon who prodded Edgar Markov into creating vampirism.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel created by Sorin to safeguard humanity; she was drawn into the Helvault.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who opposed Sorin and was imprisoned in the Helvault.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: The most powerful demon on Innistrad, who challenged Avacyn on the Helvault and was driven into it.

entities.name: Mikaeus
entities.description: The Lunarch who witnessed the battle between Avacyn and Griselbrand.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who made a demonic pact with Griselbrand and caused the Helvault's destruction.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: The Helvault's guardian, threatened by Liliana.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral in whose courtyard the Helvault stood.

events.summary: Edgar Markov inflicted vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker's spark .

events.summary: Sorin created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity.
events.quote: He created the archangel Avacyn to safeguard humanity

events.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
events.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

events.summary: Avacyn defeated demons one by one and forged the Silver Collar to bind demonkind.
events.quote: She then forged a collar of silver to bind demonkind

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels drew malevolent beings, including Nahiri, into the Helvault.
Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged Avacyn.
events.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat.

events.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
events.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

events.summary: Avacyn's imprisonment caused a crisis of faith across Innistrad.
events.quote: leading to a crisis of faith across all four provinces

events.summary: Liliana Vess threatened Thalia, leading to the sundering of the Helvault and the release of Avacyn and the demons.
events.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both Avacyn and the demons were unleashed back into the world.
